quest_text: Walk to the nearest body of water at sunrise and photograph three different reflections - a building, a tree and a person.
Pick a street you've never walked down and photograph ten doors, then arrange them into a grid collage on your phone.
Find a park bench, sit for 20 minutes and sketch the scene in front of you without lifting your pen from the paper.
Visit a free gallery or museum and choose one artwork to study for 15 minutes. Write down three details most visitors would miss.
Hike a local trail to its highest point, and at the summit write a one-sentence postcard to your future self.
Go on a 'colour walk': pick a colour and spot and photograph 15 things of that colour within a 2 km radius.
Find a bird-watching spot near water, identify five different species using a free bird app, and note what each one was doing.
Collect five different fallen leaves in a park, then identify each tree species and press the leaves inside a book.
Visit a market or grocery store from a cuisine you've never cooked, buy one unfamiliar ingredient and cook a simple dish with it.
Do a three-stop dessert crawl: try one sweet from three different bakeries within walking distance and rank them.
Find the oldest building in your neighbourhood, learn when and why it was built, and photograph one original architectural detail.
Visit a local cemetery or memorial and find the oldest legible marker. Look up one person's story online afterwards.
Record a 2-minute soundscape in three different places - a busy street, a park and a quiet room - and compare what you hear.
Find live music you'd never normally choose - a busker, an open mic or a free concert - and stay for at least three songs.
Run or walk a route that traces a simple shape (a heart, star or letter) on your GPS map and share the drawing.
Climb every staircase in a public building or park you can find within 1 km and count the total number of steps.
Do a 20-minute stretching or yoga flow outdoors on grass, then spend 10 minutes lying still and noting five sounds.
Take a 'digital sunset' evening: phone off for three hours, with a candlelit dinner, a book and an early night.
Learn to tie three useful knots from a free video, then use each one for something real around your home.
Visit your local library, ask a librarian for their favourite book in a genre you never read, and read the first chapter there.
Strike up a five-minute conversation with a shop owner and learn how their business got started.
Host a mini picnic in a park with one or two friends where everyone brings a snack that represents their childhood.
Spend an hour picking up litter along a trail or beach and log what you collect.
Write three handwritten thank-you notes to people who helped you this year and post or deliver them.
Go to a thrift store with a CA$10 budget and find an item to upcycle into something new by the end of the day.
Find a board-game café or community game night and learn one game you've never played.
Create a real-world scavenger hunt for a friend with five clues hidden around your block, then watch them solve it.
Find a rooftop, hill or bridge with a city view and watch the city lights come on at dusk.
Kayak or paddleboard a calm stretch of water for one hour, then rest on the shore and write down the best moment.
Explore a large indoor space like a mall, conservatory or train station, and find five hidden details such as plaques, murals or odd architecture.
